cloud_model.description: Cloud model used for fallback, long pages and languages the on-device model cannot write. Keep a no-billing model to stay free.

device_max_chars.description: Pages longer than this many characters are sent to the cloud model (prefer_in_cloud).

device_chunk_chars.description: Size of the pieces the on-device model rewrites, in characters.

cloud_chunk_chars.description: Size of the pieces the cloud model rewrites, in characters.

device_languages.description: Comma-separated language codes the on-device model can write. Add codes here when Chrome adds languages.

words_enabled.description: Show the 'Words to know' list (structured JSON output).

style_guidance.description: Optional extra rule appended to the rewrite system prompt, for tuning tone without a release.

android_device_max_chars.description: Android: texts longer than this go to the cloud (Gemini Nano on phones has a ~4,000-token window).

android_device_chunk_chars.description: Android: size of the pieces Gemini Nano rewrites, in characters.

android_device_languages.description: Android: comma-separated languages Gemini Nano can write (English and Korean are validated).
